description: This Java class, LoanDelinquencyStepDef, is a step definition for Cucumber BDD tests related to loan delinquency management in the Fineract system. It contains methods to verify delinquency ranges, initiate delinquency pauses and resumes, check delinquency history, and validate emitted events, among other test assertions. It interacts via REST APIs, handles test contexts, and utilizes various helper classes for error handling and event assertions.

classes.name: LoanDelinquencyStepDef
classes.description: A test step definition class for loan delinquency operations in Fineract, providing methods to verify, initiate, and manage delinquency states during automated testing.

methods.name: checkDelinquencyRange
methods.description: Verifies that the loan's delinquency range matches the expected range and delinquent date.

methods.name: checkDelinquencyRange
methods.description: Verifies a specific nth delinquency range entry, its added date, and delinquent date.

methods.name: delinquencyHistoryCheck
methods.description: Checks the delinquency history entries against expected data.

methods.name: delinquencyPause
methods.description: Initiates a delinquency pause for a loan within specified start and end dates.

methods.name: delinquencyPauseWithCreatedUser
methods.description: Initiates a delinquency pause using a created user with specific permissions, adding authorization via headers.

methods.name: delinquencyPauseWithCreatedUserNOPermissionError
methods.description: Verifies that a user without permission receives an error upon attempting a delinquency pause.

methods.name: delinquencyResume
methods.description: Resumes delinquency for a loan starting from a specific date.

methods.name: delinquencyPauseByLoanExternalId
methods.description: Initiates a pause using the external ID of the loan.

methods.name: delinquencyResumeByLoanExternalId
methods.description: Resumes delinquency by external loan ID.

methods.name: getDelinquencyActionData
methods.description: Verifies the data of delinquency actions against expectations.

methods.name: actionFieldError
methods.description: Tests that invalid action fields result in appropriate error responses.

methods.name: delinquencyPauseStartDateError
methods.description: Checks error response for pause start dates earlier than the business date.

methods.name: delinquencyPauseNonActiveLoanError
methods.description: Verifies error when trying to create a pause on a non-active loan.

methods.name: delinquencyResumeNonActiveLoanError
methods.description: Verifies error when resuming delinquency on a non-active loan.

methods.name: delinquencyPauseOverlappingError
methods.description: Ensures overlapping pause periods result in errors.

methods.name: delinquencyResumeWithoutPauseError
methods.description: Checks error when resuming delinquency without an active pause.

methods.name: delinquencyResumeStartDateError
methods.description: Verifies error for resume start date not matching current business date.

methods.name: delinquencyResumeWithEndDateError
methods.description: Checks error response when resume action has an end date.

methods.name: installmentLevelDelinquencyEventCheck
methods.description: Validates installment-level delinquency event data.

methods.name: installmentLevelDelinquencyNull
methods.description: Checks that installment-level delinquency data is null where expected.

methods.name: loanDelinquencyDataCheck
methods.description: Verifies overall loan delinquency data details.

methods.name: loanNextPaymentDataCheck
methods.description: Verifies next payment delinquency data.

methods.name: loanDelinquencyInstallmentLevelDataCheck
methods.description: Validates installment-level delinquency data details.

methods.name: loanDelinquencyPauseDataCheck
methods.description: Checks delinquency pause period data details.

methods.name: nextPaymentDueDateCheck
methods.description: Verifies that the expected next payment due date matches the loan details.

methods.name: checkDelinquencyRangeInEvent
methods.description: Checks that event data matches expected delinquency range.

methods.name: checkLoanDelinquencyRangeChangeBusinessEventCreated
methods.description: Verifies that a delinquency range change event has been raised.
